in_marathi.name: Lavanyadevi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lavanyadevi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lavanyadevi is a goddess venerated in Hinduism and Buddhism. In Hinduism, she is identified with the goddess of love and beauty, Parvati. In Buddhism, she represents the Buddhist goddess of compassion, Guanyin. Her name means 'Goddess of beauty' or 'Goddess of grace'.
